_note: Categories for the AI × AR column: AR works where AI (vision models, LLMs, generative models) is central to the idea. A work joins with `ai_cat` (in its batch file or in data/ai/*.json).

categories.desc_en: Vision and language models that recognise, read and explain what the camera sees.
categories.desc_zh: 视觉与语言模型：识别、读懂并解释摄像头看到的东西。

categories.zh: 空间里的智能体与伙伴
categories.desc_en: Characters, guides and assistants that live in your space, talk and act.
categories.desc_zh: 住在你身边空间里、会说话会行动的角色、向导和助手。

categories.desc_en: Say or sketch it and it appears: text, voice or drawings turned into 3D content in place.
categories.desc_zh: 说出来或画出来，它就出现：把文字、语音或草图变成现场的三维内容。

categories.desc_en: Live diffusion and style transfer that repaint the world you are looking at.
categories.desc_zh: 实时扩散模型与风格迁移，把你眼前的世界重新画一遍。

categories.desc_en: Pose, face and motion models that read the body and answer it.
categories.desc_zh: 读懂身体、并对身体作出回应的姿态、面部与动作模型。

categories.desc_en: Authoring, prototyping and design tools where AI and a person make AR together.
categories.desc_zh: 让人和 AI 一起做 AR 的创作、原型与设计工具。
